query_metadata.input_text: Supply of Ordinary Portland Cement 53 Grade and Portland Pozzolana Cement for Highway Bridge Construction
query_metadata.detected_language: English (with multilingual synonyms: सीमेंट, सिमेंट, சிமெண்ட், સિમેન્ટ)

primary_recommendations.title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification (Sixth Revision)
primary_recommendations.match_reason: Exact match for Ordinary Portland Cement 53 Grade. Supersedes older standalone 33 Grade (IS 269), 43 Grade (IS 8112), and 53 Grade (IS 12269) under unified standard.
primary_recommendations.scope_summary: Covers manufacture and chemical/physical requirements of 33, 43, and 53 grade ordinary Portland cement for RCC, prestressed concrete, and infrastructure works.

physical_requirements: Fineness (Specific Surface by Blaine): Min 225 m²/kg
Soundness (Le-Chatelier expansion): Max 10 mm; Autoclave expansion: Max 0.8%
Initial Setting Time: Min 30 minutes; Final Setting Time: Max 600 minutes
Compressive Strength (53 Grade): 3-day min 27 MPa, 7-day min 37 MPa, 28-day min 53 MPa
chemical_requirements: Ratio of percentage of lime to percentages of silica, alumina and iron oxide (LSF): 0.80 to 1.02
Total sulfur content calculated as sulfuric anhydride (SO3): Max 3.5% by mass
Loss on ignition: Max 5.0% by mass
marking_requirements: Net mass in kg (50 kg standard bag)
Standard BIS Certification Mark (ISI Mark CM/L-xxxxxxx)

primary_recommendations.title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification, Part 1: Fly Ash Based (Fourth Revision)
primary_recommendations.match_reason: Recommended alternative for mass concrete and hydraulic bridge piers subject to sulfate/chloride attacks.
primary_recommendations.scope_summary: Covers manufacture and requirements of fly ash based Portland pozzolana cement with pozzolanic fly ash content between 15% and 35%.

physical_requirements: Compressive Strength: 28-day min 33 MPa (matches 43/53 performance in long term durability)
marking_requirements: Standard ISI Mark with license number

version_amendment_status.latest_version: IS 269:2015 (Sixth Revision, incorporating Amendment Nos. 1, 2, 3, and 4)
version_amendment_status.outdated_warning: CRITICAL: Tender specification cites withdrawn standards IS 8112:1989 (43 Grade) and IS 12269:1987 (53 Grade). Both standards were superseded and merged into IS 269:2015. Update tender clause to IS 269:2015 (OPC 53 Grade) to prevent contractor disputes and legal non-compliance.

active_amendments.summary: Permits up to 5% performance improver additions (e.g. granulated slag, fly ash, limestone) without compromising 28-day strength.
Stricter total chloride limit (max 0.10% for RCC, max 0.05% for prestressed concrete).
Introduces QR code marking on cement bags linking to manufacturer e-test certificate and batch traceability.

gem_procurement_alignment.model_tender_clause: The cement supplied shall be 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement strictly conforming to IS 269:2015 (incorporating all current amendments). The manufacturer must hold a valid BIS Certification Mark License (CM/L) under the compulsory Cement (Quality Control) Order. The contractor shall furnish manufacturer test certificates for each consignment and submit random lot samples for testing at a NABL accredited testing laboratory as per IS 4031.
